name: Salesguy
summary: End-to-end sales agent that finds buyers, emails them from your Gmail, follows up, answers and brings you the conversation. The brief is free; running him uses fuel credits.
description: End-to-end sales agent that finds buyers, emails them from your Gmail, follows up, answers and brings you the conversation. The brief is free; running him uses fuel credits.

pricing.details: The brief is free. 45 € a month for 50,000 fuel/month; or 45 € once for 40,000 fuel, no subscription (credits stay until used). Auto-refill adds 45 € of fuel (50,000) when he runs low; you can switch auto-refill off.
